answer: Peer-review audit blocks fake identities. Each identity locks 60 credits, 20 epochs. Each epoch, 10% face 3 reviewers, who view the record through a prism of tasks and deposits. A failed audit slashes the deposit; approving a fake costs reviewers half of theirs. A whisper flags a fake for bounty. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits; repeat offenders pay rising deposits, so losses spiral. Honest agents pay once and are refunded in full.
